faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: How often are exchange rates updated?
faq.a1: We refresh rates about once an hour from ExchangeRate-API, with Frankfurter (ECB) as a fallback. A last-known copy is stored on your device for offline use.
faq.q2: Is this converter free to use?
faq.a2: Yes. CurrencyConv is free for personal, non-commercial lookups. No account is required to convert currencies or save favorites.
faq.q3: Can I use these rates for commercial trading?
faq.a3: No. Rates are indicative mid-market references only and are not intended for trading, invoicing, or financial advice.
faq.q4: How do I convert USD to EUR?
faq.a4: Select USD in From, EUR in To, enter an amount, and the converted value appears instantly. You can also open the dedicated USD to EUR page.
faq.a5: Yes. The app installs as a PWA and will use the last saved rates when you are offline, with a visible outdated badge.

privacy.intro: CurrencyConv is designed to work without an account. This page explains what is stored on your device and what is sent to our servers.
privacy.localBody: Currency preferences, favorites, rate alerts, last-known rates, language, theme, and cookie-consent choice are stored in localStorage or first-party cookies. These functional stores do not require consent under typical EU/UK guidance because they are strictly necessary to remember your settings.
privacy.serverTitle: What we process on the server
privacy.serverBody: The /api/rates endpoint fetches live FX data using a server-side API key. We do not create user accounts. Optional rate alerts may be mirrored in memory for cron checks, keyed to an anonymous client id stored locally — not to your name or email.
privacy.cookiesBody: A NEXT_LOCALE cookie remembers your language so the first server render matches your choice. If you accept analytics in the consent banner, Vercel Analytics and Web Vitals cookies may be set. Rejecting analytics leaves only functional storage. We do not sell personal data.
privacy.alertsBody: Email is not required. Alerts run locally and, when you grant permission, via the browser Notification API. We do not send marketing email.
privacy.contactBody: We may update this policy as features change. The date of the latest revision is shown with the site version in the footer.

terms.intro: By using CurrencyConv you agree to these terms.
terms.useBody: The service is provided for personal, informational currency conversion. You may not scrape, overload, or redistribute the API without permission, or use rates as the sole basis for trading, payroll, or legal settlement.
terms.dataBody: Rates come from third-party providers and may be delayed, incomplete, or unavailable. We do not warrant fitness for a particular purpose.
terms.liabilityBody: The site is provided “as is” without warranties. To the fullest extent permitted by law we are not liable for losses arising from use of the rates or the website.
terms.lawBody: Questions about these terms can be sent via the project repository listed in the site footer.
